seo.title: Careers · Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital, Kochi
seo.description: Current openings for doctors, nurses, technicians and support staff at Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital, Kadavanthra, Kochi.

hero.lead: Doctors, nurses, technicians and support staff: join a co-operative hospital that has served Kochi for over fifty years.

openings.heading: Open positions
openings.emptyText: We are not hiring for specific roles at the moment, but we keep good applications on file. Send us your CV and we will be in touch when a suitable role opens.

cv.heading: Don't see the right role?
cv.text: Send your CV with the role you are interested in. Our HR team reviews every application.
cv.fallbackText: Call us on {phone} to ask about openings.
